Medical Technician

A proud Dayton native, Kim spent three years in comprehensive ophthalmology care with a focus on cataract surgery before following a long-held dream into the world of oculoplastics. She found her home at AestheticEye, where she’s been able to grow her clinical expertise while doing work she truly loves. As a medical assistant, Kim brings a genuine warmth to every patient interaction. She has a deep passion for medical-grade skincare and laser services — the kind of enthusiasm that’s contagious and that patients notice right away.
